title: Party pages: key caps, ghost board rows, a see-through backdrop
why: Critic on 46 (3 of 5) and 56 (2 of 5): the keys were bare letters, the action names dim, the rows 45px apart, the teal ring a sentence, the empty board a card holding one line, the backdrop a flat void. Keys are key caps, names light, rows 56px, the ring a glyph, five ghost rows on an empty board, the backdrop lets the world through. Restyle only.
now: How to play shows key caps, and the empty board shows ghost rows.
